input.prompt: A realistic vertical photograph of a quiet, expensive kitchen counter in the late morning. A pale honed-stone counter runs across the lower half of the frame, with a plain warm off-white wall behind it and soft daylight raking in from the left, casting long soft shadows to the right. Standing in the centre of the counter, upright and hero-lit, is the slim orange energy drink can from the reference image: keep its orange body, its large white XS ELITE lettering and its green band exactly, small print can be simple. To the left, further back, a compact stainless steel two-slot toaster. To the right, a shallow ceramic bowl with a few pieces of fresh fruit. Just beside the can, an empty clear drinking glass. Nothing else on the counter: no clutter, no plants, no text anywhere except on the can. The top third of the frame is calm empty wall, with room for a headline. Photographic, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, real light. No person, no hands.
